To determine the day of the week for the 23rd of the month, we need to first establish the pattern of the weekdays for the 2nd and 16th. 

If the 2nd Sunday of the month is on a Sunday, then the first day of the month is a Wednesday. Therefore, the 16th of the month would be the third Sunday and would also fall on a Sunday.

Since there are 7 days in a week, we can count 7 days after the 16th to find the weekday for the 23rd. 

Sunday (16th) -> Monday (17th) -> Tuesday (18th) -> Wednesday (19th) -> Thursday (20th) -> Friday (21st) -> Saturday (22nd) -> Sunday (23rd)

Therefore, the 23rd of the month would be on a Sunday.
